endpoints.summary: Run unconditional generation. Returns a JobInfo; poll until completed.
endpoints.description: Run unconditional generation. Returns a JobInfo; poll until completed.

request_fields.name: model_name
request_fields.description: Which pre-staged model to use. `qm9` (small molecules, fast) or `geom-drugs` (drug-like, larger; novelty metric is slow — builds ~300k RDKit reference mols). Only models present on NAS are usable — check /api/models or /healthz/detail.

request_fields.name: n_molecules
request_fields.description: Number of molecules to generate. Atom counts are sampled (with replacement) from the reference dataset split.

request_fields.name: integration_steps
request_fields.description: Number of ODE integration steps. 100 is the upstream default; fewer = faster, slightly lower quality.

request_fields.name: dataset_split
request_fields.description: Reference split to sample molecule sizes from. Default `test` (smallest file). NOTE novelty always additionally loads train.smol regardless.

request_fields.name: ode_sampling_strategy
request_fields.description: ODE step schedule. `log` is the upstream default.

request_fields.name: cat_sampling_noise_level
request_fields.description: Categorical sampling noise level for discrete features (atom types / bonds).

request_fields.name: batch_cost
request_fields.description: Bucket batching cost cap (advanced). Higher = larger batches / more GPU memory.

request_fields.name: seed
request_fields.description: Random seed (lightning seed_everything). null → upstream default 12345; recorded in JobInfo.input_params.
request_fields.default_note: random seed selected by the tool at runtime

examples.title: basic generation (100 mols, qm9)
examples.notes: Returns a JobInfo; poll /api/jobs/<id> until completed, then GET /api/jobs/<id>/file/predictions.smol.sdf.

examples.title: fast smoke (10 mols, 50 steps)
examples.notes: Fastest useful call for CI / warm-up.

examples.title: drug-like generation (geom-drugs)
examples.notes: Slower — geom-drugs novelty builds a large RDKit reference set. Prefer the async task endpoint.

examples.title: FC async task mode (single 202 + blocking compute)
examples.curl: curl -X POST $URL/api/tasks/generate -H 'X-Fc-Invocation-Type: Async' -H 'X-Bioagent-Job-Id: my-job-001' -F model_name=qm9 -F n_molecules=100
examples.notes: Returns 202 immediately; FC keeps the instance alive until sampling completes. Preferred production entry.

job_lifecycle.poll_recommendation: Poll the status endpoint every 5–120 s until status ∈ {'completed', 'failed'}. On failure, JobInfo.error_summary holds a one-line exception summary and error_tail holds the trailing ~4 KB of the subprocess log — usually enough for triage without a separate /log fetch.
job_lifecycle.restart_semantics: Jobs survive process and FC instance restarts via a `job.json` sidecar in each job directory. Jobs that were RUNNING at the moment of restart are downgraded to FAILED with failure_kind='interrupted'.

nas_layout.cross_instance_consistency: When multiple FC instances mount the same NAS at jobs_base_dir, all of them can see each other's jobs via read-through cache on GET. Writes (create/update) only happen on the instance that owns the subprocess.
nas_layout.cross_service_sharing: Other bioagent services mounted on the same NAS can read this service's output files directly by path, avoiding HTTP round-trips. Example: another service does `Path('/data/rfantibody_jobs/<id>/output/file.qv').read_bytes()`.

model.name: SemlaFlow
model.paper: Irwin et al. 2024 (Semla + equivariant OT flow matching)

tool_outputs.generate: output/predictions.smol.sdf — up to n_molecules valid 3D molecules (SDF). Actual count ≤ n_molecules (unbuildable graphs skipped). output/metrics.json reports generative metrics; output/generation_stats.json reports n_valid vs n_requested.

config_tips.model_name: qm9 is fast; geom-drugs is drug-like but its novelty metric is slow (builds ~300k RDKit reference mols).
config_tips.integration_steps: 100 is the upstream default; drop to 50 for quick smoke checks.
